items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did Adagio for Strings, Samuel Barber. I play over it.

ctx.x: Have you ever done any of this stuff live?
Yeah, I’ve done some of those live. I did Adagio for Strings, Samuel Barber. I play over it.
Here’s a date for Motohiko Hino, a great drummer who’s no longer with us.
